title: The Book of Titus Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Titus — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.decoded: I, Paul, am a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, sent because of the faith shared by God's chosen people and their recognition of the truth that leads to godly living.

verses.kjv: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.decoded: This hope is for eternal life, which God—who never lies—promised long before the world began.

verses.kjv: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
verses.decoded: At the right time, God revealed his message through preaching, and he entrusted this task to me following the command of God our Savior.

verses.kjv: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
verses.decoded: To Titus, my true son in the shared faith: I wish you grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ, the Savior.

verses.kjv: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
verses.decoded: I left you in Crete so you could organize what still needs to be done and appoint elders in every town, just as I instructed you.

verses.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.decoded: An elder must be blameless, married to only one wife, and have children who are faithful and well-behaved, not wild or disobedient.

verses.kjv: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.decoded: A church leader must be blameless, like a trustworthy manager of God’s household; not stubborn, quick to anger, addicted to alcohol, violent, or greedy for dishonest gain.

verses.kjv: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.decoded: Instead, they should love welcoming others, love what is good, be self-controlled, fair, holy, and disciplined.

verses.kjv: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.decoded: They must firmly hold to the trustworthy message they were taught so they can encourage others and refute those who oppose the truth with solid teaching.

verses.kjv: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.decoded: There are many rebellious people, empty talkers, and deceivers, especially those who insist on circumcision.

verses.kjv: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
verses.decoded: Their mouths must be silenced because they ruin entire households by teaching things they shouldn’t, all for dishonest financial gain.

verses.kjv: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.decoded: One of their own prophets said, ‘Cretans are always liars, evil animals, and lazy gluttons.’

verses.kjv: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.decoded: This statement is true. So, warn them firmly, so they become healthy and strong in their faith.

verses.kjv: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.decoded: Do not listen to Jewish myths or human rules that lead people away from the truth.

verses.kjv: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.decoded: For those who are pure, everything is pure; but for those who are corrupt and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, their minds and consciences are corrupted.

verses.kjv: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.decoded: They claim to know God, but their actions prove otherwise. They reject Him by their behavior, being detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.

verses.kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.decoded: But you should teach what agrees with true and healthy teaching.

verses.kjv: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.decoded: Tell the older men to be self-controlled, serious, sensible, and strong in faith, love, and patience.

verses.kjv: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.decoded: In the same way, encourage the older women to live in a way that reflects holiness, not to slander others, not to drink too much wine, and to teach what is good.

verses.kjv: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.decoded: Their purpose is to teach the younger women to be sensible, to love their husbands, and to love their children.

verses.kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
verses.decoded: To be wise, pure, homemakers, kind, and obedient to their husbands, so that God's message is not discredited.

verses.kjv: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.decoded: Encourage the young men to be self-controlled and sensible.

verses.kjv: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.decoded: In everything, show yourself as an example of good behavior, teaching with integrity, seriousness, and honesty.

verses.kjv: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.decoded: Speak in a way that cannot be criticized, so that those who oppose you will be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about you.

verses.kjv: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.decoded: Encourage servants to obey their masters and to try to please them in every way, not arguing back.

verses.kjv: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
verses.decoded: Not stealing, but showing complete trustworthiness, so that in every way they bring honor to the teaching about God our Savior.

verses.kjv: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.decoded: God's grace, which brings salvation, has appeared to everyone.

verses.kjv: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.decoded: It teaches us to reject ungodliness and worldly desires and to live self-controlled, upright, and godly lives in this present age.

verses.kjv: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
verses.decoded: We look forward to the blessed hope—the glorious return of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.decoded: He gave himself for us to redeem us from all wrongdoing and to make us his special people, eager to do good works.

verses.kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.decoded: Teach these things, encourage others, and correct them with full authority. Don’t let anyone look down on you.

verses.kjv: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.decoded: Remind them to be obedient to authorities and rulers, to obey government officials, and to always be prepared to do good things.

verses.kjv: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.decoded: Tell them not to speak badly about anyone, not to fight or argue, but to be gentle and show kindness to everyone.

verses.kjv: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.decoded: Because we too were once foolish, disobedient, misled, controlled by various desires and pleasures, living with hatred and jealousy, and hating each other.

verses.kjv: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.decoded: But then God our Savior showed His kindness and love toward people.

verses.kjv: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.decoded: He saved us not because of the good things we have done, but because of His mercy, through a spiritual rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit;

verses.kjv: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
verses.decoded: which He generously poured out on us through Jesus Christ our Savior;

verses.kjv: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.decoded: so that, being made right with God by His grace, we become heirs with the confident hope of eternal life.

verses.kjv: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.decoded: This is a trustworthy statement, and I want you to insist on it so that those who believe in God will be eager to do good deeds. These things are good and helpful for everyone.

verses.kjv: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.decoded: But avoid pointless arguments, discussions about family histories, fights, and debates about the law, because they are useless and meaningless.

verses.kjv: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.decoded: If someone is a divisive person, after warning them once or twice, reject them.

verses.kjv: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.decoded: Know that such a person is warped, sinful, and is already condemned by their own actions.

verses.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.decoded: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to spend the winter there.

verses.kjv: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.decoded: Help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their trip, making sure they have everything they need.

verses.kjv: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.decoded: And encourage our people to learn to do good deeds that meet real needs, so they won’t be unproductive.

verses.kjv: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.decoded: Everyone with me sends their greetings to you. Greet those who love us because of our shared faith. May God’s grace be with all of you. Amen.
